description: A CSS file defining variables and styles for a web application, specifically for a Tic Tac Toe frontend, managing light and dark theme styles, component styles, layout, and animations.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application styling, centers content and sets background color based on theme.

classes.name: App-header
classes.description: Styling for the header of the application, including layout and background settings.

classes.name: App-link
classes.description: Styles for links within the application, particularly in terms of color transitions.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Styles for the theme toggle button that switches between light and dark themes.
